fato_historico: 1895: The capitulation of Tainan completes the Japanese conquest of Taiwan.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace quiet resolutions. Just as shifting tides redefine boundaries, it is a good time to release old structures that no longer serve your growth. You may find peace by acknowledging past endings, allowing space for a beautiful new chapter to bloom within your heart. Trust your intuition deeply today.
frase_do_dia: Embrace the beauty of letting go to make room for something greater.
significado_numero: A powerful cycle of completion and the promise of fresh beginnings.
conselho: Consider meditation to clear your mind and welcome fresh, positive possibilities.
